decode.scroll_stop_trick: A cartoon man, belly out and frowning on a red half, faces his own slim grinning self on a blue half, under a headline that says the product DRAINS the belly in a number of days. Loud, simple, kid-show colours.
decode.angle_carried: 'DRAINS BEER BELLY IN 14 DAYS' — Adrien: 'the aggressive winner, word for word'
decode.hidden_reading: the verb 'drains' tells him it's not fat he must burn but something that can be let out — our mechanism in one word
decode.scene_logic: same man, before on red (left, sad, belly over the belt), after on blue (right, smiling, flat), product between them; ours identical with our avatar and our pouch
decode.visual_trick: the diagonal red/blue split and the cartoon exaggeration; copy literally
decode.shape_or_function_equivalent: beer belly ↔ the same belly (A8-M); amber bottle ↔ pouch; 14 days ↔ 30 days
decode.render_style: Pixar-style 3D cartoon, saturated red and blue halves, soft shadows, white headline area on top
decode.text_treatment: condensed caps headline, the verb in red, the rest black; deadline in a red box with white text; small footnote bottom centre

strategy.angle: A8-M the man's belly that isn't fat — it drains, it doesn't burn
strategy.mechanism: M1: when the body can't clear everyday oxidative stress, the tissue in the legs stays inflamed and stops draining normally, so fluid sits there — heavy, tender, puffy — and no diet reaches it, because it was never fat; the tablet turns a glass of water into hydrogen-rich water, hydrogen is the smallest molecule there is, reaches the tissue and helps the body switch that process off so normal drainage can resume
strategy.sub_avatar: trigger: 'where did your gut go' is what he wants to hear · cause: inflamed tissue holding fluid · tried: cutting beer, sit-ups
strategy.belief_installed: A belly that no diet moves isn't food I stored — it's what my body stopped clearing.
